svg.title: Conceptual mechanical schematic
svg.desc: Two static views of the XY teaching diagram: the complete assembly and the same assembly with the wafer holder removed to expose the X-axis nut. The Y carriage carries the X assembly. The screws and guide rails are shown schematically at different heights.

g.text: Y-axis guide rails on the fixed base.
Y carriage plate: carries the X assembly.
Y-axis motor on the fixed base.
Y-axis screw rotating in bearing supports.
X-axis guide rails mounted on the Y plate.
X carriage plate: carries the wafer holder.
X-axis motor carried by the Y carriage.
X-axis screw in the X assembly.
Holder attached to the X carriage plate.
X screw bearing supports on the Y plate.
Y screw bearing supports on the base.
Wafer retention method to be selected.
Y limit sensors on the base.
The X assembly sits above the Y carriage; crossing screws in this top view are at different heights.
Schematic proportions. Discussion concept: dimensions, components and performance are not yet approved.
